store.name: BATIK
store.delivery_policy: Free shipping across Pakistan (Postex courier). Orders within Pakistan are delivered in 7-10 working days; new collections take 8-12 working days. Cash on delivery needs no advance payment.
store.return_policy: Items can be exchanged within 7 days only if they arrive damaged or defective, or do not match the product's original specifications. Report the problem within 3 days of delivery by emailing photos to care@batik.com.pk or by calling the helpline on weekdays; if the claim is approved the item must be sent back within 7 days of purchase and the customer pays the return delivery charge. Exchanges are also possible at a BATIK retail store within 7 days of delivery. Items bought at a sale price cannot be exchanged or refunded. BATIK has a no-refund policy except in exceptional cases such as an out-of-stock item; refunds take 7 working days and shipping costs are not refunded. Orders can be cancelled before they are processed. This policy applies to cash-on-delivery orders.
store.contact: Helpline 051-111-222-845 (weekdays, 9 am to 6 pm), email orders@batik.com.pk, WhatsApp 0314-5600009

source.note: Public product and policy information from BATIK's online store, copied by hand for a university course demo. Not affiliated with BATIK. Prices are the sale prices shown at retrieval time. BATIK does not publish stock counts, so stock is only 'available' or 'sold out'. Sizes, colors and fabric are filled in only for products whose product page was read (details_verified = true); for the others the bot gives the price and hands size/color questions to the seller. To add details, copy them from the product page and set details_verified to true.
